_file.description: Per-MCU, per-pin timer alternate-function and DMA option data, merged from STM32_timers.json and STM32_DMA.json (the authoritative sources, cross-checked against raw dump timers/dma CLI output from real hardware). The STM32H743 and STM32G474 DMA option lists were originally imported truncated to three entries, which is the STM32F4/F7 limit (MAX_TIMER_DMA_OPTIONS). Those parts route a timer channel to any of sixteen DMA streams/channels through DMAMUX and the firmware's option index runs 0..15, so their lists were regenerated from the firmware's own dmaTimerMapping[] and dmaChannelSpec[] (src/main/drivers/dma_reqmap.c) with the DMA_REQUEST_TIMx_CHy numbers from the vendor CMSIS headers. The list index is the firmware's dmaopt value, so order matters: DMA1 first, then DMA2, ascending. F411/F40X/F7X2/F745 are untouched.
